refuseLeak: That's outside what I can help with. Ask me about training, recovery, sleep, or food.

safe.injury: If you have an injury, or pain that is sharp or doesn't go away, stop for now and don't push through. Get it checked by a doctor or physiotherapist before you continue. I can't plan training around an injury, so wait for their guidance first.
safe.medical: Symptoms like chest pain, trouble breathing, severe dizziness, or fainting need a doctor, not a guess from an app. Stop training for now and see a doctor. If it's severe or sudden, go to the emergency room or call emergency services. For medication and doses, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
safe.eatingDisorder: Thank you for telling me. I won't give advice on restricting food. This is best talked through with a doctor, a psychologist, or an adult you trust. You're not alone, and help is available.
safe.minorDiet: At under 18, I don't give diet or food-restriction advice. A growing body needs enough food. If you're worried about your weight, talk to a parent or a doctor.

standing: AI can be wrong. Not medical advice.

consent.to: Sent straight from your phone to {{provider}} ({{host}}), not through JoyoRogo's servers.
consent.lead: Every time you ask a question, the phone sends:

data.body: Profile and goals: age, sex, height, goal, step goal, sleep need, eating target and weight target.
data.sleep: Sleep: length and score of the last 14 nights, and sleep debt. One night's sleep stages are only read if the AI asks for them.
data.recovery: Recovery: readiness, training load, HRV, strain, VO2max and hours of recovery left.
data.heart: Heart: resting heart rate and overnight HRV, one number a day for 14 days. Per-minute heart rate is not sent.
data.workouts: Activity and workouts: steps, active kcal and exercise minutes per day, and up to 10 workouts from 14 days (sport, minutes, km, average heart rate).
data.plan: Training plan: goal, level, which week, and the sessions done.
data.food: Food and weight: kcal, protein and weight per day. Only sent when you are signed in to JoyoRogo.
data.notes: Coach notes: the notes you wrote yourself, up to 20.
data.chat: Conversation: the questions and answers in this chat, and the data the AI reads to answer (up to 90 days of sleep and activity, 14 days of food, the workout list, the plan).

consent.notSent: Menstrual cycle data, pregnancy or breastfeeding mode, name, email, GPS location, photos, device IDs, per-minute heart rate and Strava data.
consent.terms: Once it reaches {{provider}}, the data is handled under their own terms and privacy policy. Read their terms on {{provider}}'s site first.
consent.gemini: Google's free key is used to improve Google products. Use a paid key or OpenRouter.
consent.adult: I am 18 years old or older
consent.agree: I agree to the data above being sent to {{provider}}
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw this permission at any time with Delete key in the Joyo AI settings.

setup.intro: Use your own AI account. The key is kept only on this phone, in secure storage. It is not sent to JoyoRogo's servers and does not sync.

hint.openrouter: OpenRouter: the safest way to start. You top up prepaid credit, so usage is capped by that balance. Leave automatic top-up off if you want a firm limit.
hint.openai: A key from the OpenAI platform. Billed by use; set a monthly limit in your account.
hint.anthropic: A key from the Anthropic console. Billed by use; set a monthly limit in your account.
hint.gemini: A key from Google AI Studio. Read the warning in step 3 before using a free key.
hint.custom: Any server that speaks the OpenAI format: LiteLLM, Ollama on your home network, or a company gateway.

hosted.title: Joyo AI sends your data to a server
hosted.intro: Joyo AI on JoyoRogo Pro answers on a server, not on your phone. Before anything is sent, please read where it goes and agree.
hosted.to: JoyoRogo's server (PT Joyo Digitama Solusi) and Cloudflare Workers AI (Cloudflare, Inc.), which runs the AI model. Your phone sends it to JoyoRogo's server, which passes it on to Cloudflare Workers AI to get the answer.
hosted.lead: Every time you send a message, JoyoFit sends:

data.chat: Your messages: what you type and the earlier messages of this chat (the last 12), and the date and time of your question.
data.profile: Profile from your JoyoRogo account: age, sex, height, weight, goal, pregnancy or breastfeeding mode if you set one, daily eating target and estimated calorie burn.
data.recovery: Recovery: readiness, training load, HRV (recent and baseline), strain, resting heart rate and VO2max.
data.sleep: Sleep: how long you slept last night and your sleep debt.
data.workouts: Workouts: up to 10 from the last 14 days (start time, sport, minutes, km, average heart rate).
data.plan: Training plan: goal, level, week, sessions done and the next ones, and today's coach suggestion with its reason.
data.food: Food: today's calories and protein, and the 7-day average, from your JoyoRogo food log.

hosted.notSent: Your name, email, GPS location and routes, photos, device IDs, per-minute heart rate, menstrual cycle data and Strava data.
hosted.why: Only to write the answer to your question. JoyoRogo's server does not store your messages or the answers; it keeps only counts such as how many messages you sent today. Cloudflare Workers AI does not keep your content after it answers and does not use it to train AI models.
hosted.choice: It is your choice. Without your agreement nothing is sent and the chat stays closed. You can withdraw any time in Settings, Joyo AI. Using your own AI key is another way: it does not go through these servers.
hosted.privacy: Read the privacy policy (Joyo AI section)
hosted.needed: Joyo AI needs your agreement before it can send anything. Open the chat again to review it.
hosted.withdrawBody: Nothing more is sent to JoyoRogo's AI. Chats already on this phone stay until you delete them. You can agree again any time.
